decisions.reason: As a flagship electric heating line aligned with the firm's lower-carbon direction and in-house R&D, the firm can assimilate market feedback and improve it, so withdrawal is very unlikely.
Although adjacent to existing infrared heating and learnable via in-house R&D, it lacks flagship focus and thus has a somewhat higher but still limited withdrawal risk.
Close to the firm's core industrial hall heating, the firm can readily interpret performance data and refine the line, making near-term withdrawal unlikely.
Hydrogen-capable gas infrared builds directly on deep gas-heating knowledge and cooperative R&D, and the real-world pilot supports learning, so it is very likely to be kept.
